instruction: Use the opened Autodesk Revit environment and its automation interfaces to export the completed model to C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc as IFC4. At the start of the task, use `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe` as the Revit entry point for this automation. Do not create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process IFC outside Revit. The current model is a plain three-storey mixed-use block. The architect wants the building reorganized so the ground floor reads as retail with back-office support, the upper floors become paired studios and labs, and the top is capped by a modest sloped roof. Keep the regular frame and stacked floor plates coherent.
